guidance.title: Lyon airport ↔ Part-Dieu
guidance.description: Rhônexpress links Lyon Saint-Exupéry airport and Part-Dieu in about 29 minutes. Published service runs daily, with 15–30 minute frequencies. This planner conservatively admits airport arrivals 06:00–21:59 and departures 08:00–22:59 local; these are planning limits, not departure times. Allow for airport formalities, the tram wait and travel to your hotel. Buy transfers separately and confirm the timetable.

guidance.title: Getting to and from the match
guidance.description: OL publishes direct tram shuttles from Part-Dieu Villette Sud to Groupama Stadium (normally under 20 minutes), with return shuttles after matches. Reserve the event transport ticket and check fixture-specific operating times and away-supporter instructions before booking. T7 changes operation when event shuttles start. Exact Palace-match shuttle times and fares are not yet confirmed.

guidance.title: Changing stations in Paris
guidance.description: Eurostar uses Gare du Nord; the Lyon TGV uses Gare de Lyon. Eurostar describes the RER D connection as about 30 minutes. The planner requires at least three hours between trains in each direction, including walking and border/security time on the return. Connections are restricted to daytime and early evening. Local tickets cost extra; separately purchased train tickets do not automatically guarantee missed-connection protection. Check Eurostar arrival requirements before travel.
